name: Juicy Jays | Terp Enhanced Hemp Wraps | Grape Soda
description:
Juicy Terp Enhanced Hemp Wraps are bursting with natural flavors! Infused with natural terpenes that add a gust of fruity flavor to each inhale. The Terp Enhanced wraps have even more natural essences infused into each 2-pack pouch.

Juicy Jays are known for their impressive array of delicious flavors, and their blunt wrap line is expanding now, too. The Terp Enhanced hemp wraps are a tobacco-free way to add a pop of flavor to any bud being rolled up. Packed in a convenient 2-pack pouch, roll up both or save a wrap for later. These hemp wraps burn slow and even. The infuse flavors complement both the natural terpenes in the hemp wrap and those in the flower itself, for a very robust, well-rounded smoking experience.

TERP ENHANCED | The Juicy Terp Enhanced hemp wraps are bursting with flavor. These have the maximum amount of terpenes infused to complement the natural flavors for a super flavorful experience.

2PK POUCH | These hemp wraps are packaged in resealable mylar pouches. They are packed with two hemp wraps and a packing stick.

HEMP WRAPS | Juicy Terp Enhanced hemp wraps are a great tobacco-free alternative. They are free of harmful tar and additives, enhancing rather than detracting from a lovely smoke session.
